source_evidence: PLAYER exact directive "Investigate and take any evidence and loot" at Day281~21:01 Station Kestrel 30x30ft inner secured RECORDS/REAGENT VAULT, unlocked iron entry door already OPEN, V and Fenar inside. This authorizes searching record shelves, central document cabinet and sealed administrative cases, plus safe portable valuables, without unchosen destruction of evidence, hazardous experimentation, spellcasting, spending limited resources or fabricating high-level secrets. Scene time ~21:01–21:09, no combat/guard entry observed. V Intelligence(Investigation)+3 with feasible Fenar Help sorting/holding document cases and lighting, DC15 for sorting significant true station authorizations and useful evidence from other documents: GENUINE executed Python secrets RNG advantage d20 FACES(17,8), choose17+3=20 vs DC15 SUCCESS. V opens and reads central original administrative case and files, preserves existing reference/seal markings in case: (A) original regional station special-medical-operations authorization directive bearing director-physician CORVEN NASK's name and Western Service Directorate regional bureau official seal; (B) TWO original controlled experimental program order sets labeled EVERMARCH (endurance testing) and CLEAR WILL (behavioral reconditioning), containing explicit provisions for restraint and continuing subjects' procedures despite objections, corroborating firsthand witness and signed local trial/injury notes; (C) original secure transfer/requisition ledger with patient transfers, supply numbers and research program authorization references, correlating to eleven living patients and six contradicted reported discharges in V's prior folios. These original records establish LOCAL station and regional bureau authorization/complicity but NOT verified personal approval by higher political officials, who caused divine deaths, full Western Program hierarchy, or any unplayed broader atrocity. No names/acts inferred beyond witnessed documents and source-eligible fixed truth; no preexisting paper erased. V takes these ORIGINAL packet(s) in their original labeled case: one station authorization, two program orders and one secure ledger, into V CUSTODY, plus earlier V-held 2 administrative folios, signed local trial/injury packet and Magister mundane component pouch. Fenar independently reacts with justified anger to explicit nonconsent procedures, no forced moral reaction or decision by V. For reagent storage, V reads handling labels; Arcana Intelligence+0 nonproficient, DC15 to recognize broad alchemical/arcane laboratory classes and safe handling without claiming novel magical item function. GENUINE executed Python secrets d20 FACE19+0=19 vs DC15 SUCCESS. Finds SIX intact small sealed portable REAGENT VIALS in original PADDED CASE, now itemized as 2 binding-ink mixtures, 2 refined crystalline component mixtures and 2 preservative-salt preparations; recognizes classes not active potion healing, usable magical effects or exact safety in consumption; does NOT unstopper, touch contents, cast magic or try them. Collects one small SILVER-FITTED PRECISION MEASURING INSTRUMENT from the existing packed material storage; mundane tool, enchantment/valuation not claimed. Fenar consents to carrying 6 sealed vials/padded case and silver-fitted measuring instrument in FENAR custody; loot has research/possible resale value but NO appraised price, GP credit, magic-item property or attunement. V's and Fenar's normal carrying constraints accommodate small records and one case. The secure storage room remains containing bulky shelving, ordinary records and discarded/broken nonportable containers; no loose money, confirmed enchanted weapon or other obvious portable treasure identified during competent search (do NOT pretend a preauthored magical reward or invent cash). No magic ward activated during ordinary handling, though unseen magical hazards not globally disproved. Original Kestrel private prep authorizes limited original vault records linking local station to regional bureau and a reagent vault, not automatic divine killers or top-level signatures. Original alarm remains audible; KN-G1 Veteran in administration and KN-G4 front gate guard still uncontacted and not magically aware, no new reinforcement or unplayed action. No changed/restored health: V48/48 HP AC19 HD7/7 Superiority1/4 Psi0/6 MP7/7 PastLife0/3 PsiRecovery0/1 ActionSurge0/1 SecondWind1/1; Fenar51/59HP AC14 Rage INACTIVE, 2/4 remaining Rage uses, Shift3/3 MP6/6 Bestial Soul CLIMB40. Earlier Helmed Horror destroyed0/60 wreckage outside open vault; laboratory WEST DOOR still locked, bound unconscious stable KN-M1 Magister0/40 on table and KN-G6 Guard0/11 bound behind cabinets with V-owned50ft rope, other G2/G3/G5 guards and KN-M2 apprentice still unconscious stable absent causal intervention; original site bell continues. Cirren51/51HP full spells/CD2 independently escorts all11 liberated patients (8 walking,3 on three proper stretchers) south toward Mara and four healthy V-owned horses/coach, arrival/care NOT yet confirmed or automatically resolved. V purse969gp3sp6cp, rations12 ration-person-days/feed16 animal-days, Pixie Dust packet1 sealed, weighted LongRest5/6 incomplete, Psychic Whispers V↔Fenar/Cirren expires~22:56. No V destruction, future retreat, magical identification or other consequential choice assumed. NEXT V decision: leave vault/withdraw with evidence toward patients, check further specific concern, or another deliberate action.
